full_page.content:
1951, April 24
The following is the faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Mrs. Constance Gantz 2203 Yucca Dr. Silver City, New Mexico
Blessed be God in all His designs. April 24th 1951
God bless you Mrs. B. B. - Paul R. Gantz. Congratulations
How can we ever thank God as we ought to do, for all His mercies and blessings to us - - His wonderful designs and works and ways.
I wanted to write several times but ...? Wondering how poor "Mack" were doing - - and his many (non Catholic) friends. .. Keep up your prayers - courage and always on guard against worry, etc.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
